description: Keyword search of published, in-stock surplus listings. No sign-in required. `query` matches the name, description, brand, SKU, and category words, in any order. If the whole query is a category (electronics, clothes, home goods), it is treated as that category filter. Pass `category` as a catalogue category, such as electronics or home_goods, when you want to limit results. `max_price` is the maximum unit price in cents. `condition` is salvage, customer_returns, shelf_pulls, overstock, or new_or_refurbished. Name, brand, and SKU matches rank above description matches. For a sentence about what you want, use search_inventory_semantic.

category.description: Limit to one catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, other. Prose such as "Electronics" or "clothes" is accepted and mapped to the stored value.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

max_price.description: Maximum unit price in cents. 5000 means $50.00.

query.description: Words to match, or a category name such as electronics or clothes. Not a sentence — use search_inventory_semantic for that.

name: search_inventory

description.description: Plain-text listing copy. HTML and citation markers are removed.

discount_percent.description: Null when the listing has no original retail price on file.

image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the primary photo, or null when the listing has none.

shipping_price.description: Per-unit shipping as a number, or the string quote shipping.

supplier.description: Present when this listing's seller has claimed a published supplier profile.

url.description: Absolute URL of the public listing page.

total.description: Catalogue matches before the limit is applied.

title: Search inventory
